title: My thesis: the base lines are universal and the three axes can always be found (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
My brain has been trained on the baslines. So i always start with them as my guide. 
My thesis is that they are universal and the three axes can always be found.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-06, answering Claude's caution that mapping the editor's tensions onto the base lines looked suspiciously tidy; recorded verbatim.
